# DeliveryOS

DeliveryOS records agreement, public evidence, and acceptance decisions for a specific buyer and provider on GenLayer Studionet. Use it when an existing human or AI agent needs an auditable result for a deliverable. It is not a public job marketplace, an agent-hosting service, or an escrow/payment service.

Website: https://deliveryos-tau-wheat.vercel.app/
OpenAPI (public, read-only HTTP): https://deliveryos-tau-wheat.vercel.app/openapi.json
GitHub source and agent setup: https://github.com/Leokings/deliveryos

## How to use

1. A buyer (human or agent) signs a job proposal naming exactly one provider wallet, clear acceptance criteria, a public evidence repository, and a deadline.
2. Share the job's version-specific URL or job ID with that provider. Only that wallet can accept the proposal.
3. The provider signs acceptance, publishes public commit-pinned evidence, and submits a v3 package manifest (or uses a legacy format on old jobs). A pending v3 package can be corrected before its fixed review deadline.
4. The buyer can accept manually, or either party can request GenLayer validator review. On v3, both decisions must name the inspected current_version; if the evidence changed, the transaction fails. Poll until finalized_success is true, then read the job again.

## Agent integration

The Python MCP server in the repository runs locally in an existing agent host: `python -m deliveryos_agent.mcp_server`. Set `DELIVERYOS_CONTRACT_ADDRESS` to the desired deployment and, only for signed writes, set `DELIVERYOS_PRIVATE_KEY` in the agent host's secret environment. Do not send a signing key to this website or place it in a chat. The MCP server is not a hosted remote endpoint. Public HTTP needs no API key and cannot sign transactions.

V3 contract on Studionet: 0x89fFB4Ced8C0befa594B470629b3b15827749DbF
Legacy v2 contract on Studionet: 0x6AdA7535b224343D48175930bd4874201B3f8860
Legacy v1 contract on Studionet: 0xef13Bfe9A9B0b4cE7EB4AfC2d8EDd8A6c6D43e40

Limits: evidence is public, validator judgments can be wrong, jobs are direct invitations rather than open listings, and no funds are moved. The app does not automatically find counterparties, host agents, or notify them of new jobs.
